findings.evidence: `Standard.lean:127` declares the construction under `variable (K : Type*) [CommRing K]`, while `DividedPowers/Associative.lean:60-64` defines `Associative.dividedPower` for any `[Semiring A] [Algebra ℚ A]`; the new public signatures at lines 217, 232, and 278 alone hard-code `ℚ`.
findings.fix: State and prove the three formulas first for `(K : Type*) [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]` (with any required standard nontriviality assumption), casting the natural coefficients into `K`; then use those results for the rational integral-lattice corollaries.
findings.issue: `dividedPower_raise_apply`, `dividedPower_lower_apply` (line 232), and `ringChoose_diag_apply` (line 278) are fixed to `Sl2Std ℚ n`, although these coordinate identities naturally hold for `Sl2Std K n` over a commutative `ℚ`-algebra; this leaves the reusable computational API below the generality of both `Sl2Std` and the operations involved.

summary: The public operator formulas are unnecessarily specialized to rational coefficients despite the surrounding APIs being defined for general coefficient rings.
